sources.title: deepseek-v4.1-flash Model by Deepseek-ai | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is a multimodal mixture-of-experts model from DeepSeek-AI that accepts text and images, generates text autoregressively, supports a combined context of up to one million tokens, and provides continuously controllable reasoning effort.
